topic: Technical discussion on date picker library
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on technical challenges related to a specific date picker component (ngxDaterangepickerMd). [p1] noted that the component relies heavily on Moment.js. Someone suggested that it might be possible to change the underlying time provider and specifically mentioned removing the moment-tz plugin for timezone handling. However, [p1] expressed uncertainty about removing moment-tz due to deep dependencies within the system, aiming to complete the task with minimal disruption.
